title: Ba Be Lake View Homestay
description:
Ba Be Lake View Homestay is located in Pác Ngòi village, Ba Be National Park. We offer nice accommodation with the best view to the lake. We also arrange some special activities in Ba Be National Park, such as: boat trip, biking, swimming, bamboo rafting, trekking, visiting cave.
Let's come and enjoy with us.

title: Ba Be National Park
description: These Adventure Tours at Ba Be National Park are designed for adventure lovers who dream of exploring mystical caves, trekking through thick tropical jungles, and sleeping in the forest. Each tour will have a local English-speaking guide who will accompany you on your adventure through the wild and exciting landscapes of Ba Be National Park.
